text:
```yaml
name: Build macOS Binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Build macOS binary
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --target-arch arm64 a2a_scanner.py

      - name: Archive binary
        id: archive-binary
        run: |
          tar czf a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz dist/a2a_scanner

      - name: Upload binary to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v3
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/${{ steps.archive-binary.outputs.artifact }}
          asset_name: a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Update Homebrew formula
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/homebrew-ai-defense.git
          cd homebrew-ai-defense
          sed -i '' "s/version '.*'/version '${{ github.ref_name }}'/" Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          git add Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          git commit -m "Update version to ${github.ref_name}"
          git push origin master
        env:
          HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}
```
